title.ar: Palatial Standalone Villa for Sale in Oriana 2 |

description.en: Prestigious 6-bedroom standalone villa in Oriana 2, New Cairo. Private garden, covered parking, shared spa, balcony, and maids room with premium finishes. Secure exclusive compound offering the ultimate luxury lifestyle.
description.ar:
A rare opportunity to own a prestigious standalone villa in the heart of "Oriana 2," the most sought-after residential enclave within Cairo Festival City (CFC). This property offers expansive living spaces and architectural elegance, providing the perfect canvas for you to design your dream home with your personal touch (Semi-Finished).

Nestled in a community that redefines luxury, this villa ensures maximum privacy and security, all while being just minutes away from world-class shopping, dining, and international business hubs.

Property Specifications:

Location: New Cairo – Cairo Festival City (Oriana 2).

Land Area: 690 sqm.

Built-up Area (BUA): 417 sqm.

Condition: Semi-Finished.

Internal Layout:

6 Spacious Bedrooms (Versatile distribution).

Grand Reception & Dining areas.

Dedicated spaces for a private garden and outdoor living.

Exceptional Features:
 Strategic Location: Heart of the Fifth Settlement, walking distance to Cairo Festival City Mall, IKEA, and top-tier international schools.
 Absolute Privacy: A massive private garden surrounding the villa, ideal for family gatherings and serene living.
 Investment Value: Oriana villas represent one of the highest appreciating real estate assets in Egypt.
 Elite Community: 24/7 advanced security, professional facility management, and a vibrant, upscale neighborhood.

Financial Details:

Asking Price: $1,900,000 USD.

Property Code: OR2-6R-1.9M$
